top_categories.workout_context: 77ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At mile 60 of 100, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
At Dead Swede Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Dead Swede Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 100 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Dead Swede Gravel's Bighorn foothills gravel, Wyoming ranch country forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 100 miles.
7,671ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Dead Swede Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
7,671ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
100 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 100 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 7,671ft of climbing on Wyoming high plains gravel does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Dead Swede Gravel’s 100 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Dead Swede Gravel. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Dead Swede Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on wyoming high plains gravel to build confidence. Expect: bighorn foothills gravel, wyoming ranch country, chip-timed community race.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Durability, and Over Under to prepare you for 100 miles of wyoming high plains gravel in Sheridan, Wyoming (Kendrick Park).
